activity_a.text:
Remember we often use these or similar time markers in the sentences in the Simple Past Tense. 
අපි බොහෝ විට සරල අතීත කාලය තුළ වාක්‍යවල මෙම හෝ ඒ හා සමාන කාල සලකුණු භාවිතා කරන බව මතක තබා ගන්න.
சாதாரண இறந்த காலத்தில், நாம் பெரும்பாலும் இது போன்ற காலக் குறிகாட்டிகளை வாக்கியங்களில் பயன்படுத்துகிறோம் என்பதை நினைவில் கொள்க.

activity_b.text:
Choose the correct form of the verb 'to be'. Use the past tense only when the time markers clearly indicate that the action happened in the past.
'to be' යන ක්‍රියා පදයේ නිවැරදි ස්වරූපය තෝරන්න. ක්‍රියාව අතීතයේ සිදු වූ බව කාල සලකුණු පැහැදිලිව දක්වන විට පමණක් අතීත කාලය භාවිතා කරන්න.
'To be' வினையின் சரியான வடிவத்தைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கவும். காலக் குறிகாட்டிகள் அந்தச் செயல் கடந்த காலத்தில் நடந்ததை தெளிவாகக் உணர்த்தும் போது மட்டும் இறந்த காலத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தவும்.

activity_c.text: The safety officer is always responsible for checking all warning signs at SLGTI.
The trainees were very attentive during the inspection yesterday morning.
The technical instructors are usually very strict about protective clothing.
The technical officer was in the restricted zone two days ago.
The trainees in all 6 sections are always very careful when handling flammable substances.
The maintenance workers are busy because the alarm system was faulty last night.
The storekeeper is responsible for keeping all safety equipment in order.
The heads of departments were satisfied with the installation of the new warning systems last May.
The demonstrators were in the workshop when the emergency signal was first tested in 2023.
The Principal was disappointed because the procedures were not followed correctly during tests three weeks ago.

activity_c.text: There are many causes of accidents like negligence, unsafe work areas, misuse of tools and equipment and failure to use protective equipment.
Here are six common causes of accidents.
Unsafe housekeeping: injuries from slips and trips are common in unsafe work areas.
Holes, spills, garbage, debris, improperly stored items: poor housekeeping causes slips and trips.
When garbage and tools are left lying around, or holes are not covered, accidents can happen quickly.
Falling hazards: a fall is bound to happen when someone repeatedly fails to look where they are going.
Other falling hazards lurk on stairwells with loose guardrails, or with things stored on the steps.
A simple fall can be life changing, or even fatal.
Misuse of stepladders: a tipped over stepladder is a leading cause of injury or long term disability.
Failure to set the feet on solid level ground or using the top steps can lead to fatal falls.
Don’t leave tools on a stepladder, they hurt when they fall off.
Misusing a stepladder may not seem dangerous, but it can lead to a permanent disability.
